summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Docking Vestibule. Opening image: Docking vestibule. The StarTrust Operations Liaison steps onto Stardust with one compact case and no entourage. Middle image: Astra gives the smallest professional smile. Closing image: Jax checks the first route clearance.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Docking vestibule. The StarTrust Operations Liaison steps onto Stardust with one compact case and no entourage.
PANEL 2 — Astra meets them with Jax slightly behind, route slate in hand.
PANEL 3 — Astra gives the smallest professional smile.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison almost smiles.
PANEL 5 — Jax checks the first route clearance.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: I liked the parts that said "unknown."

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Good. We have several more of those.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax leads the Liaison through the operations level. The route is clean but visibly working, not staged. Middle image: The Liaison notes it. Closing image: The Liaison nods.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax leads the Liaison through the operations level. The route is clean but visibly working, not staged.
PANEL 2 — They pass the properly racked passive-collection bins.
PANEL 3 — Jax shakes his head.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison notes it.
PANEL 5 — Jax raises the route slate.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison nods. Jax was prepared for a fight and does not get one.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Those were in the original installation location?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Astra brings the Liaison into the lab work area where Mira has sealed samples and physical test records ready. Middle image: The Liaison looks at her. Closing image: The Liaison nods once.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra brings the Liaison into the lab work area where Mira has sealed samples and physical test records ready.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison sets down the case.
PANEL 3 — Astra answers before Mira can.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison looks at her.
PANEL 5 — Astra continues.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison nods once.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We can show you samples, conditions, tests, and chain of custody. We cannot schedule the phenomenon.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Good. If you can stage it, I don't need a site visit.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira lays out the retained physical test results and sealed samples accumulated from earlier station incidents. Middle image: The Liaison holds still, hands off the tablet, giving the crew space to answer. Closing image: The Liaison writes exactly that down.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira lays out the retained physical test results and sealed samples accumulated from earlier station incidents.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison asks directly.
PANEL 3 — Mira does not look at Astra before answering.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison holds still, hands off the tablet, giving the crew space to answer.
PANEL 5 — Mira adds.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison writes exactly that down.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: What condition reliably produces high-cohesion material?

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: We have physical context. We have samples with different properties. We do not have a predictive behavioral mechanism.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Glorp presents the local reporting workflow. Middle image: The Liaison looks at NO ENTRY — INTENTIONAL BLANK. Closing image: Kreeb looks at Glorp, pleased but not sentimental.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp presents the local reporting workflow.
PANEL 2 — Glorp points to the required sample fields.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb points to the intentional blank category.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison looks at NO ENTRY — INTENTIONAL BLANK.
PANEL 5 — Glorp visibly braces.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb looks at Glorp, pleased but not sentimental.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Material traceability is complete from collection through test.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Personal disclosure is not required to complete the record.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Observation-glass alcove off Stardust Station's working operations level. Opening image: The Liaison asks Astra to step aside near the observation glass. Middle image: The Liaison turns from the bracket status to the active lab visible beyond the glass, calm and matter-of-fact. Closing image: The Liaison does not threaten her.
settingText: Observation-glass alcove off Stardust Station's working operations level; bright maintained corporate-station interior with the active lab visible nearby.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison asks Astra to step aside near the observation glass.
PANEL 2 — Beside the observation glass, the Liaison rests one hand on the compact case and gestures toward the temporary-bracket status visible across the working level.
PANEL 3 — Astra glances toward the still-temporary bracket status.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison turns from the bracket status to the active lab visible beyond the glass, calm and matter-of-fact.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks back at the lab.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison does not threaten her.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: A material pilot is easier to fund than "interesting operations."

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Then tell me what I can put my name on.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: The tour resumes through the galley service corridor. Middle image: Astra automatically begins to redirect the Liaison away. Closing image: Astra gives up on the instinct to smooth it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The tour resumes through the galley service corridor.
PANEL 2 — A station alert sounds: GALLEY WATER MANIFOLD — PRESSURE LOW.
PANEL 3 — Zib stops mid-step.
PANEL 4 — Astra automatically begins to redirect the Liaison away.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison looks at the alert.
PANEL 6 — Astra gives up on the instinct to smooth it.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Is this part of the tour?

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Jax checks the planned visitor path. The low-pressure manifold is directly ahead. Middle image: A worker starts to enter the service area. Closing image: Jax looks back at the Liaison.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax checks the planned visitor path. The low-pressure manifold is directly ahead.
PANEL 2 — He closes that route segment and opens a safe bypass on his slate.
PANEL 3 — A worker starts to enter the service area.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison watches him enforce the detour without asking Astra.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks back at the Liaison.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Not through here. Use the blue corridor.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Zib opens the manifold service cabinet. Middle image: Astra asks the operational question. Closing image: Station system announcement: GALLEY SINK TWO TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE. The Liaison watches the crew treat this as exactly the size of problem it is.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the manifold service cabinet.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the sensor history.
PANEL 3 — Zib finds a sticking regulator actuator.
PANEL 4 — Astra asks the operational question.
PANEL 5 — Zib points to the secondary galley branch.
PANEL 6 — Station system announcement: GALLEY SINK TWO TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE. The Liaison watches the crew treat this as exactly the size of problem it is.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Pressure drop started four minutes ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We lose one sink. Nobody dies of thirst.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Zib isolates the affected branch. Middle image: Zib removes the actuator cover. Closing image: The Liaison asks Astra quietly.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib isolates the affected branch.
PANEL 2 — Jax keeps the service path clear and updates the route slate.
PANEL 3 — Mira compares commanded and actual actuator position.
PANEL 4 — Zib removes the actuator cover.
PANEL 5 — Pixa logs elapsed response time and affected service count.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison asks Astra quietly. Astra watches the crew.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Command is clean. Response is lagging.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: One fixture unavailable. No other service impact.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Zib cleans the actuator track. Middle image: Astra handles the station notice and galley user complaints. Closing image: The Liaison sees the whole response happen without a central heroic command.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib cleans the actuator track.
PANEL 2 — Mira verifies sensor response.
PANEL 3 — Jax prevents a supply cart from entering the open service zone.
PANEL 4 — Astra handles the station notice and galley user complaints.
PANEL 5 — Glorp logs the temporary isolation while Kreeb puts a simple sign on the unavailable sink.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison sees the whole response happen without a central heroic command.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We distribute everything quickly. Usually because no one has enough hands.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: Zib cycles the actuator. Middle image: Jax reopens the route segment. Closing image: Zib closes the cabinet.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib cycles the actuator.
PANEL 2 — Pressure returns to normal.
PANEL 3 — Mira confirms the trend.
PANEL 4 — Jax reopens the route segment.
PANEL 5 — Pixa reports.
PANEL 6 — Zib closes the cabinet. The Liaison accepts the hit.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Total service interruption: eleven minutes, forty-two seconds.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Long because we had a tour.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Galley Service Corridor. Opening image: After the repair, Mira notices a small incidental residue seam near a warm cable junction beside the service cabinet. Middle image: Mira looks at them. Closing image: Mira seals the sample.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — After the repair, Mira notices a small incidental residue seam near a warm cable junction beside the service cabinet.
PANEL 2 — She waits until the area is closed and safe before sampling it.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison watches.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks at them.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison clarifies.
PANEL 6 — Mira seals the sample.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Was that caused by the disagreement?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Back in the lab, the Liaison compares two sets of records: material samples and operational incidents. Middle image: The Liaison points to the second list. Closing image: The Liaison shakes their head.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Back in the lab, the Liaison compares two sets of records: material samples and operational incidents.
PANEL 2 — Material side: LOW MASS / VARIABLE PROPERTIES / NO DEFENSIBLE PREDICTOR.
PANEL 3 — Operations side: INCIDENT DETECTION / LOCAL OWNERSHIP / SERVICE ISOLATION / REPAIR CLOSURE.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison points to the second list.
PANEL 5 — Astra sees what they mean.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison shakes their head.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Astra pulls the old inspection result. Middle image: Astra looks slightly embarrassed by the phrase. Closing image: Brick remains at the edge of the room while nobody engages him.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra pulls the old inspection result.
PANEL 2 — The inspector's conclusion is visible: STATION REMAINS ACTIVE — ADAPTIVE RESPONSE ACCEPTABLE.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison reads it.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks slightly embarrassed by the phrase.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison returns the file.
PANEL 6 — Brick remains at the edge of the room. Nobody engages him.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We thought that was a polite way to say "messy but useful."

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Astra has her original material-pilot talking points open. Middle image: Mira watches. Closing image: Mira corrects her.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra has her original material-pilot talking points open.
PANEL 2 — She deletes: POTENTIAL YIELD / SCALE PATH / PRODUCTION CONDITIONS.
PANEL 3 — She replaces them with: UPTIME / RESPONSE TIME / LOCAL OWNERSHIP / PASSIVE MATERIAL CHARACTERIZATION.
PANEL 4 — Mira watches.
PANEL 5 — Astra answers without looking away from the screen.
PANEL 6 — Mira corrects Astra. Astra looks at her.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: The Liaison closes their case. Middle image: Astra looks at the sample tray, then the operations record. Closing image: The Liaison nods toward the operations record.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison closes their case.
PANEL 2 — The Liaison sets the closed compact case on the lab bench beside the sample tray.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks at the sample tray, then the operations record.
PANEL 4 — Astra keeps the sample tray and the operations record side by side on the bench, one hand braced between them.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison nods toward the operations record.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: I can recommend a limited pilot. Central review will ask what it produces.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I am not selling certainty we do not have.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra, Mira, Glorp, Kreeb, and the Liaison write the local trial terms. Middle image: Kreeb adds. Closing image: The Liaison adds the last local term.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, Glorp, Kreeb, and the Liaison write the local trial terms.
PANEL 2 — Astra states the first term.
PANEL 3 — Mira states the second.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb adds.
PANEL 5 — Glorp adds.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison adds the last local term. Astra notices the qualifier.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Material chain of custody remains complete.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The Liaison shows Astra the recommendation form before submitting it. Middle image: The Liaison points at the review note. Closing image: The Liaison is precise.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison shows Astra the recommendation form before submitting it.
PANEL 2 — Program description: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS SITE WITH INCIDENTAL MATERIAL CHARACTERIZATION.
PANEL 3 — Astra reads it twice.
PANEL 4 — The Liaison points at the review note.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at them.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison is precise.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: Central finance may still ask for a material benchmark.

dialogueInline.speaker: LIAISON
dialogueInline.text: I said no target from me.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Docking Vestibule. Opening image: The visit is ending. Jax walks the Liaison back toward docking. Middle image: Jax looks at the badge. Closing image: Jax puts the badge in the return slot.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The visit is ending. Jax walks the Liaison back toward docking.
PANEL 2 — He checks off the final route segment.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison hands back the temporary visitor badge.
PANEL 4 — Jax looks at the badge.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison gestures toward the repaired galley corridor.
PANEL 6 — Jax puts the badge in the return slot.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The Liaison departs. Middle image: Astra does not celebrate yet. Closing image: Astra looks at the new attachment.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison departs.
PANEL 2 — Astra's terminal receives: SITE RECOMMENDATION SUBMITTED.
PANEL 3 — Mira stands beside her.
PANEL 4 — Astra does not celebrate yet.
PANEL 5 — Pixa chimes.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at the new attachment.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: That went better than I expected.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: A person visited. The system still gets a vote.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Close on the central review message: LIMITED PILOT — PROVISIONAL. Middle image: Third line, larger: TARGET MASS UPDATED. Closing image: Astra looks at the target, then at the still-open operating record.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Close on the central review message: LIMITED PILOT — PROVISIONAL.
PANEL 2 — Second line: MATERIAL BENCHMARK GENERATED FROM OBSERVED SITE DATA.
PANEL 3 — Third line, larger: TARGET MASS UPDATED.
PANEL 4 — Mira reads the number and immediately frowns.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the target, then at the still-open operating record.
